PROP-0000-create-asm-004.text: Only service_role can invoke admin operations; no authenticated bypass path exists.
PROP-0000-create-asm-004.assertion: forall op in admin_ops: requires_role(op, service_role) AND NOT callable_by(op, authenticated)

locations.note: Uses SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY directly (not cookie-based SSR); bypasses RLS for admin DB operations
Uses both createClient (anon/authenticated) and createAdminClient (service_role) — admin client only for user metadata update, not for member insert
All admin server actions gate on is_admin field check via createClient (RLS-enforced); if is_admin=false, throws before any privileged operation
